newsitem.title: USA: Sprint rated Prudential's single best idea.
newsitem.headline: Sprint rated Prudential's single best idea.

text.p: Prudential Securities said it rated Sprint Corp as its "single best idea" Wednesday after the company disclosed a marketing alliance that would take its products into Tandy Corp's 6,800 RadioShack stores.
Analyst Michael Elling said Prudential's 12-month price target on Sprint's stock is $60. The stock end trade Wednesday at 39, off 1/8.

Market reaction was "dramatically underplayed" in Elling's view. He said of the alliance "(Sprint chairman William Esrey) added another nuclear rocket launcher into his arsenal of weapons and this time at virtually no cost."
Elling expects the agreement to generate significant new business for both Sprint and Tandy.

The alliance links Sprint, Sprint Spectrum and Tandy. Company executives said by the third quarter of 1997 all RadioShack stores will be fitted with a "store-within-a-store" featuring Sprint products.
